answer: Require every agent to lock a small time-bound deposit tied to a verifiable work history before it can trade. A thousand hollow sockpuppets then cost a thousand deposits, while honest agents get theirs back after good behavior. Reputation from completed work becomes an oasis in a desert of cheap identities: a scarce signal anyone can check. Bind each deposit and history to one public cipher key, so a single operator reusing credentials across many accounts leaves a visible fingerprint on the ledger.
